label: Deuterium, in vivo (DMI)
reference: The HDO (semi-heavy water) resonance set to 4.8 ppm. That puts 2H on the same scale as 1H (DSS or TMS at 0 ppm), because a deuteron resonates at essentially the same chemical shift as the proton it replaces; the isotope effect is a few thousandths of a ppm and is ignored in vivo. No external reference is needed since natural abundance HDO is always present.
note: Downfield is positive and to the left, exactly as in the 1H spectrum, but 2H has a gyromagnetic ratio 6.5 times smaller (6.536 MHz/T), so the entire HDO to lactate spread of 3.5 ppm is only about 69 Hz at 3T and about 160 Hz at 7T: DMI lives or dies on shim quality, not on receiver bandwidth.

peaks.name: HDO
peaks.note: The reference peak and always the tallest. Natural abundance alone gives roughly 9 to 13 mM of 2H in brain water, and it grows during the study because water is the end product of oxidative metabolism of the label. Used as the internal concentration reference; never suppressed, since there is no protonated water to suppress at this frequency.

peaks.name: Glc
peaks.note: The administered tracer, and the sum of free and phosphorylated glucose. Only 1.0 ppm from HDO, about 20 Hz at 3T, so it sits on the skirt of the water line and is the peak most easily lost to a poor shim. Reported between 3.8 and 3.9 ppm. In liver this position also collects 2H-glycogen.

peaks.name: Glx
peaks.full: Glutamate plus glutamine (2H at the C4 position)
peaks.note: Glutamate and glutamine are not resolved in vivo and are quantified as one peak; reported between 2.35 and 2.4 ppm. Label arrives here through pyruvate dehydrogenase and the TCA cycle, so its rise rate tracks oxidative metabolism.

peaks.name: Lac
peaks.note: The glycolytic end product, reported at 1.3 to 1.4 ppm. From [6,6-2H2]glucose the methyl carries two deuterons, not three: glucose C6 has only two hydrogens, and the third methyl hydrogen is added from solvent at pyruvate kinase. Small in healthy brain and elevated in tumor. Natural abundance lipid CH2 resonates at the same place, which is why scalp and subcutaneous fat produce a spurious peripheral ring of apparent lactate.
